Join AmeriCorps Today. When you join AmeriCorps, you commit to improving lives and strengthening communities through service. Submitted by Anonymous (not verified) on Tue, 11/24/2020 - 04:56 Choose AmeriCorps. You have the power to make a difference and change lives, including your own. Join AmeriCorps and AmeriCorps Seniors to channel your passion into service, kickstart your career, or make an impact in your community. The choice is yours. Join Now Toolkit Spread the word! Use our Choose AmeriCorps toolkit to find video, audio, photos, sample social media, templates, and more. Access the Toolkit Serve with AmeriCorps Enrich your life by helping others. When you choose to serve with AmeriCorps and AmeriCorps Seniors, you join a network of people and organizations dedicated to strengthening communities and making a difference. Find your fit Build a Partnership AmeriCorps is more than a service program; it’s a network. Becoming a grantee is just one way to partner with AmeriCorps. We engage the private sector, foundations, and higher education institutions in a number of strategic partnerships. Become a Partner Donate Your Time Thousands of volunteer opportunities are waiting for you. Choose to make a difference starting where you are and when you can. Find an opportunity Register Your Opportunity Publicize your volunteer opportunities by adding them to AmeriCorps Volunteer Search. Create a free project listing with one of these organizations: Idealist , JustServe , or VolunteerMatch . About AmeriCorps AmeriCorps provides opportunities for Americans of all backgrounds to serve their country, address the nation’s most pressing challenges, improve lives and communities, and strengthen civic engagement. Find out more What We Do AmeriCorps brings people together to serve communities. AmeriCorps and AmeriCorps Seniors offer individuals and organizations flexible ways to make a local and lasting impact while focusing on six key areas to make an impact. Learn more
summary: AmeriCorps funding opportunities aim to support programs that improve lives and strengthen communities through service. Eligible applicants include organizations, institutions, and individuals committed to community impact and volunteerism. Deadlines and specific requirements vary by program, with a focus on strategic partnerships and service initiatives. Applicants are encouraged to align with AmeriCorps' mission of fostering collaboration and addressing community needs.
